mechanisms.statement: Timestamp drawn on the instructing bank's local clock (fixed January UTC offsets): office curve starting 07:00
Local weekday shares Mon 18.9 · Tue 17.0 · Wed 17.0 · Thu 18.0 · Fri 18.9 · Sat 3.6 · Sun 6.5 % for every country
Weekly volume = base × level(week), the same level for every country
level(week) is piecewise-constant and changes only at week boundaries (Mondays)
ln(USD_AMOUNT) ~ Normal(6 + 2·[ORDERING_TYPE=B] + 2·[BENEFICIARY_TYPE=B] + c_country + b_bank, σ ≈ 2.08)
Sending-country level c_country shifts ln(amount) (≈ −3.2 … +2.0); beneficiary country has ≈ no effect
Within-country residual of ln(amount) is Normal → amounts lognormal; no power-law tail
USD-denominated amounts keep whole-unit roundness (≈39% end .00, ≈16% multiples of 100); non-USD amounts have uniform cents (≈1%)

blueprint.covers: which currency it is sent in

mechanisms.statement: CURRENCY_CODE = home currency of the instructing bank with probability ≈ 0.93 (country-specific 0.73–0.98)

CURRENCY_CODE is drawn from the route: home currency of path[1] (≈95% if direct), else the receiver bank's currency (≈3.8%), else an intermediary's currency (≈+2.4 pts per intermediary), else a global vehicle (≈1.3%)
On replaced rows, CURRENCY_CODE and the local clock follow path[1] (instructing bank); account IBAN and ordering address follow ORDERING_BIC8 (account-servicing bank)

unresolved.text: Vehicle-currency selection mechanism not fully identified.
Relies on our data-derived country→currency map.

blueprint.covers: which banks send, relay and receive

mechanisms.statement: Intermediaries are sampled with probability proportional to bank activity, not from the payment-currency zone
Intermediaries are drawn i.i.d. with replacement, P(b) ∝ size(b)^β with β ≈ 1
Sender and receiver banks are NOT paired independently; pair counts deviate from n_i·n_j/N even within country pairs and unique relationships
Each bank has its own business-customer share on the sending side and on the receiving side
With probability 0.05 the first known path BIC is replaced by another bank; independently, with probability 0.05 the last known BIC is replaced

unresolved.text: Mechanism of the affinity (bank-level preference lists?) not identified.

blueprint.covers: how many hops, which type, what is hidden

mechanisms.statement: Number of intermediaries K ~ ⌊Exp(1)⌋; PARTICIPANT_COUNT = K + 2
Among non-direct routes, TRANSACTION_TYPE = Covered with a sending-bank propensity π_b (cover banks π ≈ 0.6–0.8, others π ≈ 0.05); independent of K
Each link between consecutive known BICs is hidden ('...') independently with p = 0.05; extra '...' per hidden link ~ Geometric(0.05)
CONTINUITY_QFLAG := 'N' if BIC8_PATH contains '...', else 'Y'
PARTICIPANT_COUNT := number of BIC8 entries in BIC8_PATH that are not '...'
CURRENCY_CONVERSION_COUNT := Σ over consecutive known BICs of 1[home_ccy(country(bᵢ)) ≠ home_ccy(country(bᵢ₊₁))]
TOTAL_DURATION ≈ Σ over participating banks of a step: fast (seconds) with probability STP(b), manual otherwise
Manual-step probability depends on the bank only, not on hour, weekday or amount
Manual step ~ Gamma(k ≈ 2, θ ≈ 817 s); two fast steps ~ Gamma(k ≈ 3.1, θ ≈ 8.7 s)

unresolved.text: Fitted on pc=2 rows with exactly one slow bank.

mechanisms.statement: Account is IBAN-formatted only for banks in IBAN countries; IBAN country prefix = BIC country; one IBAN length per country
Ordering address country = ORDERING_BIC8 country; beneficiary address country is drawn independently of BENEFICIARY_BIC8
BENEFICIARY_TYPE is drawn independently of ORDERING_TYPE

blueprint.covers: engineered token summaries of the details fields

mechanisms.statement: BENEFICIARY_TYPE is drawn independently of ORDERING_TYPE

blueprint.note: Token fields are engineered pattern summaries supplied with the data, not original text. We measured their presence and co-occurrence (Token page) but found no generator rule beyond the layout and party-type structure in P1b/P4 — this section is deliberately thin rather than padded.

mechanisms.statement: ROMANCE_SCAM: consumer → same beneficiary, 2–8 payments minutes apart, each ≈ ×1.5 the previous; all labelled
DUPLICATE_PAYMENT: 2–5 identical copies (sender, beneficiary, amount, path, duration) within ≤ 2 h; every copy labelled
FAT_FINGER_MISTAKE: amount × 100 (≈77%) or ÷ 100 (≈23%)
CEO / ACCOUNT_REPLACEMENT scams pay accounts that receive only anomalous money (mules) at small, often manual banks
CUSTOMER_RECALL rows are statistically indistinguishable from normal rows on all tested features
ANOMALY_TYPE is assigned independently of TRANSACTION_TYPE
